title: Making open models work for long-horizon agentic workloads
summary: Prefix caching helps coding agents stay fast as conversations grow. Prompts, tool calls, and inference routing determine how much work the model can reuse.

title: Speech models in Ollama
summary: Ollama now supports speech models, starting with Phonon from Gradium. Read text aloud in five languages and dozens of voices, streamed as it is generated, over 100 times faster than real time on Apple Silicon.

title: Clef is available on Ollama's cloud
summary: Clef, a 27B multimodal decision model from Cloudflare, is now available on Ollama. Run it locally or on Ollama's cloud.

title: Reflection's Beam is freely available on Ollama for a limited time
summary: Reflection's first open-weight model is now available on Ollama, and free for a limited time only. Beam is designed for software engineering, reasoning, and long-running agentic tasks. Access Beam through Ollama's cloud.

title: Run AI agents safely with Ollama and Fly.io
summary: AI agents can now use Ollama's cloud models safely inside Fly.io's cloud computers.

title: Ollama now supports Jev-style decision models
summary: Ollama now supports decision models, based on TypeSafe's Jev API for fast, typed decisions. Decision models can now be run at no cost with low latency. Based on text, decision models answer yes-or-no questions, choices and scores about it, with a probability for every option.

title: Ollama's transparent pricing
summary: Ollama's Pro, Max, and Team plans now use industry-standard per-token pricing with usage included on every plan.

title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
summary: Claude Desktop can now be configured to work with Ollama as a third-party gateway provider, making it possible to use open models in Claude.

title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
summary: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now available on Ollama. It's a 30 billion parameter (3B active) open model built for agents that stay running, gathering context, calling tools, and working through multi-step tasks on your own hardware.

title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
summary: Meta's Muse Glimmer, the first open model released by Meta Superintelligence Labs, is now available. Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model released under the Apache 2.0 license, designed for local coding agents, and accelerated by Ollama's MLX engine with new native DFlash and image input support.
